messages:
maria: Heads-up — I started a long-context run against qwen-7b with batch=4 and seq=16k, and KV memory climbs steadily across the session, not plateauing like with llama.
kai: Can you paste the exact command and a tiny telemetry snippet?
maria: repro: `python bench_long_context.py --model qwen-7b --seq 16384 --batch 4 --repeat 6`
Telemetry sample (tok progression):
  tok 0: kv_pages_resident=1_180_000
  tok 5k: kv_pages_resident=1_350_000
  tok 25k: kv_pages_resident=1_870_000
Observed: p50 token latency +12%, p95 +30% vs baseline.
Also saw periodic small GC spikes but evictions don't reclaim expected pages.
dave: I think this lines up with the kernel-selection change (commit 3f9a2c) that swapped to the new ringlet prefetch heuristic. Might be over-prefetching on Qwen because of rope scaling behavior.
perf-bot: :warning: Regression alert: qwen-7b-longseq pipeline — kv_pages_resident growth (compare to baseline). See dashboard: https://perf.redwood/qwen-longseq/3072109999
kai: Quick profiler snippet from the run (top hot counters):
  kv_page_evictions: 6.3%
  kv_page_allocs: 47k/s
  page_frag_score: 0.68
  kernel_switches_per_batch: 0.9
Note: Llama runs have evictions ~0.7% and frag_score ~0.42 on same config.
maria: interesting — guess is the prefetch window (default 256 ringlets) is causing many partially-filled ringlets for Qwen because rope scaling maps tokens to more sparse slots.
dave: that matches an offline replay I did — Qwen's rotary/head-split results in less locality in the slot index, so prefetch pulls extra pages that are never used, leaving fragments.
kai: quick experiment idea: reduce prefetch window to 64 or make it adaptive based on recent slot hitrate. I repro'd locally: prefetch=64 -> evictions 1.9%, frag_score 0.47, but p50 latency up ~4%.
maria: we should tradeoff cost vs latency. For production, eviction spike causes memory bloat and OOM risk on pinned nodes, so probably prefer lower prefetch on long-context Qwen workloads.
dave: proposal: implement a runtime flag so we can toggle prefetch per-model (feature-flag, no deploy risk). I'll add `kv.prefetch.window.per_model` with default=auto. Patch plan: small gate in kernel selector -> skip aggressive prefetch for models flagged longseq-qwen.
kai: also suggest collecting `kv_page_map` + `heap_samples` during the canary to validate fragmentation maps. Add a histogram of slot-hit-distance to the console.
maria: can you push the canary? If it's feature-flag only we can roll to 10% dedicated capacity. Also want to run a 24h replay with mixed prompts (prefix reuse heavy and random seq).
dave: will push tiny flag patch and run canary: `./deploy canary --tag kv-prefetch-toggle-qwen --scope dedicated-qwen-7b --pct 10`
I'll attach logs to this thread when ready.
perf-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary queued. Trace id: cb9a7f. Will notify on completion.
kai: next-day data plan: collect kv_pages_resident, page_frag_score, page_eviction_rate, and token p50/p95. Keep same request mix as the alert run.
maria: thanks — running overnight full replay now. I'll post results in morning (seeded prompts attached to the job).
